svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ColdFusion and CFML Developer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Language Fundamentals: Running CFML with CommandBox, Tags, script and variables, Arrays, structs, lists and queries, Decisions and loops, Scopes and request input, Functions and components, Code style and naming; 02 The Framework: Application.cfc and the request lifecycle, ColdBox projects and CommandBox, Routing and handlers, Interceptors, WireBox and models, Configuration and environments, Reading older CFML applications; 03 HTTP and REST APIs: REST API design, Resource routes, JSON in CFML, Status codes and headers, Filtering and pagination, Browser clients and AJAX, API documentation with OpenAPI; 04 Databases and Data Access: SQL foundations, Datasources and bound parameters, Migrations, Query builder, Data integrity and transactions, Efficient queries, Quick ORM; 05 Validation and Error Handling: Validation with cbvalidation, Error response format, Exception handling, Logging with LogBox, Debugging a request across layers; 06 Authentication and Authorization: Password storage, API tokens, Rules and permissions with cbsecurity, Sessions and cookies, Rate limiting sign-in; 07 Background Jobs and Caching: Scheduled tasks, Background jobs and idempotency, Sending email, Caching with CacheBox, Locking and shared state; 08 Testing: Unit tests with TestBox, Integration tests for ColdBox, Mocks and test doubles, Contract tests and coverage, Characterising older code; 09 Security and Performance: Injection and output encoding, Engine and server hardening, CORS and security headers, The security and code review checklists, Query performance and indexes, File uploads, Load testing; 10 Deployment and Operations: Reproducible server set-up, Docker images, CI/CD pipelines, Production database migrations, Lucee and Adobe ColdFusion compatibility, Health checks and monitoring
svg.text: The security and code review checklists
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
